terms.definitionEn: An element whose children are laid out in rows and columns by the Grid layout system.
terms.definitionAr: عنصر أبناؤه بيتوزعوا في صفوف وأعمدة باستخدام نظام Grid.

terms.definitionEn: A property that defines the explicit grid's column tracks.
terms.definitionAr: خاصية بتحدد مسارات الأعمدة الصريحة في شبكة Grid.

terms.definitionEn: A flexible track unit representing a share of available space after fixed track sizing.
terms.definitionAr: وحدة مرنة بتمثل حصة من المساحة المتاحة بعد حساب المسارات الثابتة.

terms.definitionEn: A track-list function that duplicates a pattern a specified number of times or with an automatic track-count keyword.
terms.definitionAr: دالة لمسارات الشبكة بتكرر نمط عدد مرات محدد أو باستخدام كلمة تكرار تلقائي.

terms.definitionEn: Spacing placed between grid tracks without creating outer space around the grid container.
terms.definitionAr: مسافة بين مسارات الشبكة من غير ما تعمل مساحة خارجية حوالين الحاوية.

terms.definitionEn: A track sizing function that sets a minimum and maximum size range for a grid track.
terms.definitionAr: دالة لتحديد أقل وأكبر حجم لمسار من مسارات الشبكة.

terms.definitionEn: A property that names regions in a grid using strings whose rows describe the layout.
terms.definitionAr: خاصية بتسمي مناطق في الشبكة باستخدام نصوص كل واحد منها بيوصف صفًا.

terms.definitionEn: A property that assigns an item to a named area or specifies its grid line placement.
terms.definitionAr: خاصية بتحط العنصر في منطقة باسم محدد أو بتحدد مكانه بخطوط الشبكة.

terms.definitionEn: An auto-repeat keyword that fits as many tracks as possible and collapses empty repeated tracks.
terms.definitionAr: كلمة للتكرار التلقائي بتحط أكبر عدد مسارات ممكن وبتطوي المسارات الفاضية.

terms.definitionEn: An auto-repeat keyword that fits as many tracks as possible while preserving empty repeated tracks.
terms.definitionAr: كلمة للتكرار التلقائي بتحط أكبر عدد مسارات ممكن وبتحتفظ بالمسارات الفاضية.

terms.definitionEn: Tracks created automatically when placement needs rows or columns outside the explicitly defined grid.
terms.definitionAr: مسارات بتتعمل تلقائي لما مكان عنصر يحتاج صفوف أو أعمدة خارج الشبكة الصريحة.

terms.definitionEn: A numbered or named boundary used to place an item across grid tracks.
terms.definitionAr: حد مرقم أو مسمى بيستخدم لتحديد مكان العنصر على مسارات الشبكة.

questions.question: What does this value do to the catalog's children?
options: Places them in a two-dimensional grid layout
Turns them into a single flex row
Positions each child relative to the viewport
Makes each child an inline text run
questions.explanation: display: grid establishes a grid formatting context for the element's children.
questions.explanationAr: display: grid بتعمل سياق Grid لأبناء العنصر.

questions.question: How many explicit column tracks are declared?
options: Twelve tracks followed by one track
questions.explanation: The two space-separated track sizes define two explicit columns.
questions.explanationAr: حجما المسارين المفصولين بمسافة بيحددوا عمودين صريحين.

questions.question: How is available flexible space divided between these tracks?
options: The first receives twice the second's share
The second receives twice the first's share
The second track is fixed at 2 pixels
questions.explanation: The fr factors use a 1:2 ratio of the space available to flexible tracks.
questions.explanationAr: قيم fr بتقسم المساحة المرنة بنسبة واحد لاتنين.

questions.question: What track pattern does this expression create?
options: Three columns each fixed at one pixel
questions.explanation: repeat(3, 1fr) repeats one equal flexible column track three times.
questions.explanationAr: repeat(3, 1fr) بتكرر عمود مرن متساوي 3 مرات.

questions.question: How many explicit equal column tracks are declared?
questions.explanation: The repeat count creates three explicit column tracks.
questions.explanationAr: عدد التكرار بيعمل 3 مسارات أعمدة صريحة.

questions.prompt: Establish grid layout for this gallery.
questions.explanation: The grid display value creates a grid container.
questions.explanationAr: قيمة grid بتعمل حاوية Grid.

questions.explanation: The first repeat argument is the number of copies of the track pattern.
questions.explanationAr: أول قيمة في repeat بتحدد عدد مرات تكرار نمط المسار.

questions.question: Where does gap add space in this grid?
options: Inside every grid item's content box
questions.explanation: gap creates gutters between grid rows and columns.
questions.explanationAr: gap بتعمل مسافات بين صفوف وأعمدة الشبكة.

questions.question: How does grid-area: nav place this item?
options: It creates a new area named nav
It names the second column main
It sets a 1fr gap around the item
questions.explanation: A grid item's grid-area name associates it with the matching named template area.
questions.explanationAr: اسم grid-area بيربط العنصر بمنطقة لها نفس الاسم في القالب.

questions.code: .grid { width: 640px; display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr); column-gap: 32px; }
questions.question: What is the width of each equal track, assuming no padding or border?
questions.explanation: The gap uses 32px, leaving 608px for two equal tracks of 304px each.
questions.explanationAr: المسافة 32px وبتتبقى 608px لعمودين، يعني 304px لكل واحد.

questions.prompt: Allow an auto-repeat to fit as many minimum-12rem tracks as possible.
questions.explanation: minmax sets the lower and upper sizing bounds for each repeated track.
questions.explanationAr: minmax بتحدد الحد الأدنى والأعلى لحجم كل مسار متكرر.

questions.prompt: Name the first row's regions nav and main.
questions.explanation: Quoted area names describe the layout of a grid row.
questions.explanationAr: أسماء المناطق بين علامتي اقتباس بتوصف ترتيب صف الشبكة.

questions.question: What happens to repeated tracks that remain empty?
options: They are always kept at exactly 14rem
questions.explanation: auto-fit collapses empty repeated tracks after fitting as many tracks as possible.
questions.explanationAr: auto-fit بتطوي المسارات المتكررة الفاضية بعد ما تحدد أكبر عدد ممكن.

questions.prompt: Place the article in the named main area.
questions.explanation: The item's grid-area value must match the template area's name.
questions.explanationAr: قيمة grid-area للعنصر لازم تطابق اسم المنطقة في القالب.

questions.question: How does auto-fill treat empty repeated tracks?
options: It preserves them in the grid when space allows
It always collapses them after placement
It converts them into columns with fixed pixel widths
questions.explanation: auto-fill preserves empty tracks in the repeated pattern when the container has room for them.
questions.explanationAr: auto-fill بتحتفظ بالمسارات الفاضية لو الحاوية فيها مساحة كفاية.

questions.prompt: Repeat as many minimum-14rem tracks as fit, retaining empty tracks.
questions.explanation: auto-fill fits as many repeated tracks as possible and keeps empty ones.
questions.explanationAr: auto-fill بتحط أكبر عدد مسارات ممكن وبتحتفظ بالفاضي منها.

questions.question: What is the ending grid-line number for this placement?
questions.explanation: The end line is explicitly set to grid line 4, so the item spans the track between lines 2 and 4.
questions.explanationAr: خط النهاية محدد برقم 4، فالعنصر بيمتد بين الخطين 2 و4.

questions.question: Which behavior distinguishes this auto-repeat from auto-fit?
options: It collapses every unused track after placement
It creates no tracks until items are inserted
It retains empty tracks when space permits
questions.explanation: auto-fill preserves empty tracks, whereas auto-fit can collapse empty repeated tracks.
questions.explanationAr: auto-fill بتحتفظ بالمسارات الفاضية، أما auto-fit ممكن تطويها.

questions.prompt: Start this item at grid line 2 and end it at line 4.
questions.explanation: The second grid line value in this placement is the ending line.
questions.explanationAr: قيمة خط الشبكة التانية في التحديد هي خط النهاية.

questions.prompt: Set a row track to at least 5rem and allow it to grow to fit content.
questions.explanation: minmax provides a minimum track size and an automatic upper size.
questions.explanationAr: minmax بتحدد أقل حجم للمسار وبتسمح بأقصى حجم تلقائي.

questions.question: How do explicit and implicit grid tracks differ?
keyPoints: Explicit tracks are declared by grid-template properties
Implicit tracks are created by placement beyond the explicit grid
Auto track sizing controls implicit tracks
Both kinds participate in the final grid
questions.modelAnswer: Explicit tracks are defined with properties such as grid-template-columns and grid-template-rows. When placement requires tracks beyond that definition, the grid creates implicit tracks whose sizes can be controlled with grid-auto properties.
questions.explanation: A grid can include tracks authored directly and tracks created as layout requires.
questions.explanationAr: الشبكة فيها مسارات محددة صراحة ومسارات بتتعمل تلقائي لما التخطيط يحتاجها.

questions.question: Compare auto-fit and auto-fill in a repeated grid pattern.
keyPoints: Both calculate how many tracks fit
auto-fit can collapse empty repeated tracks
minmax commonly sets a responsive track range
questions.modelAnswer: Both keywords fit as many repeated tracks as possible in the available space. auto-fill retains empty tracks, while auto-fit can collapse those empty tracks after placement, allowing occupied tracks to expand.
questions.explanation: The difference is the treatment of empty tracks after fitting.
questions.explanationAr: الفرق الأساسي هو التعامل مع المسارات الفاضية بعد تحديد عددها.

questions.question: How do named grid areas help express a page layout?
keyPoints: grid-area assigns an item to a matching name
Names can make a layout easier to read
questions.modelAnswer: grid-template-areas describes named regions as quoted strings, with each string representing a row. Items use a matching grid-area name to occupy those regions, which can make a page layout easier to understand.
questions.explanation: Named regions provide a readable alternative to line-only placement for many layouts.
questions.explanationAr: أسماء المناطق بتخلي وصف التخطيط أوضح من الاعتماد على أرقام الخطوط بس.

questions.question: What does the fr unit represent in grid track sizing?
keyPoints: It represents a fraction of available flexible space
Fixed sizing and gaps are accounted for
It is not a fixed pixel unit
questions.modelAnswer: An fr value represents a share of the space available to flexible tracks after fixed track sizes and gutters are accounted for. Minimum sizing constraints can affect the final distribution, so it is not simply a fixed percentage or pixel value.
questions.explanation: Fractional tracks distribute remaining available space subject to track constraints.
questions.explanationAr: وحدة fr بتوزع المساحة المرنة المتبقية مع مراعاة قيود أحجام المسارات.
